issues: The verse identifies the reader only as “he”; his identity is unspecified. The reading action is supported, but avoid depicting any listeners or the account’s described afflictions and journey as present events.
The facts and narration are supported. Population comparisons are not a present visual event; keep any visual treatment abstract and do not depict the groups assembled.

Summary and explicit facts match the verses. Visual inference of a single assembled body at a time is supported by Alma moving between bodies; avoid implying the earlier bondage deliverance occurs in the scene.

The summary's account of the Spirit, blessing, and prosperity is source-supported, but the verses describe no visible manifestation; depict no divine figure, supernatural light, or other specified visual form for the Spirit.
